title: Well, hello there.
description: A small beginning. A place for thoughts, experiments, stories, and whatever else feels worth writing.
author: spideythedev

content.text: Well, this is a place to write. Anything, really.
No content schedule. No pressure to sound smart. No need to turn every thought into something profound.
BlogStar is an open space for people who have something to say. Ideas, experiments, stories, lessons, random observations — all welcome.
You don't need a reason to write. Sometimes writing is the reason.
